tools.description: Agent Flight Recorder — FREE (1 monitor per alert target) / Gateway key (20 monitors + stored capsules + fleet view). Register an agent or scheduled job to be watched: you get a monitor_id + secret; the agent then calls heartbeat every period_minutes. If heartbeats stop for period + grace, the alert target (Discord/HTTPS webhook and/or email) is notified with the last state capsule and a resume link.

alert_email.description: Email address to alert (Gateway key tier only; capped at 10 emails/monitor/day)

alert_webhook.description: Discord webhook URL or any HTTPS webhook (receives JSON)

grace_minutes.description: How late a heartbeat may be before alerting (default 5)

name.description: What is being watched, e.g. "nightly ETL loop"

tools.name: register_monitor

tools.description: Agent Flight Recorder — "still alive" ping for a registered monitor. Include capsule (any JSON ≤32KB: current step, done, next, ids) so a dead-man alert can carry resume state (stored on the key tier). status:"fail" reports a failure immediately.

capsule.description: Resume state: { step, done: [...], next, ids: {...} } — anything JSON

secret.description: Monitor secret from register_monitor (not needed when calling with the owning Gateway key)

tools.name: heartbeat

tools.description: Agent Flight Recorder (Gateway key) — get the last state capsule a monitored agent sent, to resume from where it died.
tools.name: fetch_capsule

tools.description: Agent Flight Recorder (Gateway key) — every monitor you own: alive / late / dead, last heartbeat, capsule preview.
tools.name: fleet_status

tools.description: Agent Flight Recorder — remove a monitor (needs its secret or the owning key).
tools.name: delete_monitor
